title: achillea alpina subsp. subcartilaginea
intro: Achillea alpina subsp. subcartilaginea, commonly known as Alpine Yarrow, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the daisy family, native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to promote health and well-being, with reported benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the severity of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Yarrow include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a natural antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
